_comment: A REAL revocation notice issued by the deployed service (revision hodi-evidence-endpoint-00045-dkz) on 2026-08-14T17:29:42Z, captured verbatim. Nothing here was constructed: this is the artifact the hero beat's cascade emits, signed by Cloud KMS with a private key that has never left KMS. It exists so .github/workflows/verify-live.yml can prove the verification property WITHOUT holding the signing key — CI verifies a production artifact against the live public key, rather than signing something for itself and checking its own work, which is a closed loop that proves nothing about production.
_what_a_failure_here_would_mean: Either the deployed service is serving a public key that is not the KMS key it claims (substitution), or the key version behind already-issued receipts has been rotated away, which would silently invalidate every provenance claim Hodi has published.
